Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the finished island composition to retain. Image 2 is the selected MARSH PAINTING reference for quiet environmental color, simple atmosphere and broad water shapes. Image 3 is selected CHARACTER RENDERING reference only. Make ONE ENVIRONMENT-REGION PAINTOVER, preserving all people, equipment and physical contacts exactly.

Repaint ONLY the sky, distant landscape, open water, reeds and non-contact decorative surface marks of the decking. Replace the dominant orange-red sky/sunset and its orange reflection stripe with restrained slate-grey cloud planes and a small quiet ochre horizon glow. Water reads as broad matte slate-blue/grey planes with a few broken low-contrast ripples. Distant trees and reeds group into soft silhouettes like image 2. Simplify the equal-bright scratch/gravel/plank/reed microdetail into larger quiet painted shapes; keep selective irregular ink where it describes a real silhouette, joint or necessary structural edge. Preserve dusk readability and local material colors with varied tonal masses, rather than applying any overall dark overlay. Preserve the full perspective and structural timber geometry.

PROTECTED EXACTLY: all FIVE figures, their faces, hair, garments, hand anatomy and poses; all sleeves and fingers; Efim's continuous shovel, both grips and same upper-chest contact below the grey figure's clear head; Efim's forward sole on the board, board top and its two bearing contacts; Nastasya's two hands on the supported end; M's shield, single sheathed left-side sword, free right arm and existing garment values; one rope coil and two rolled nets. Do not repaint the characters or their material-condition patches. Keep the same round charcoal mound, shelter, posts, channels and camera framing, with their legible structural contours. The physical contact regions must stay exact and clear. This task changes environmental rendering/value grouping only, not composition or contact geometry.

Finish as the same coherent serious folklore graphic-novel scene with irregular major ink contours and broad matte washes. Quiet environmental planes let the existing characters and essential support edges read first. No text, border or UI. Opaque wide frame; preserve the input crop and dimensions.
